title: Adding QoL Updates to Older games.
author: Xenobyte_VT
selftext: Recently I've started playing through my old library of games from franchises that have long since had many QoL updates over the years (I.e Pokemon with shared party exp and catching experience, or Digimon with being able to have full box and digi lab access in game menu). So I've begun to test AI to see if I could add these QoL improvements to these old games and I've had some success and I'm beginning to question is this ethical or even appropriate to do?

Look up nintendo roms. I think there's some legal precedent there where you can do stuff to old games but you just can't sell it.

comments.author: Xenobyte_VT
comments.body:
Well with certain games like Digimon World 2 and Digimon World 3 you'd think they'd be just slight 1 ups of each other but they're completely different from each other and like way different than anything like Digimon Time Stranger or Cybersleuth. Cybersleuth to Time Stranger is basically like the Ruby and Sapphire to Diamon and Pearl  jump while like DW2 to DW3 is like Pokemon Diamon and Pearl to Pokemon Rangers or Mystery Dungeon. 

The games being so functionally different adds layers that I know I'm too dumb to figure out on my own.
